description: Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency - Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by publishing the prohibited substances list for equestrian sports and horse racing, which falls under the category of regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
